title_en: Your Brain Deletes Your Blurry Vision
reveal_en: Every time your eyes rapidly shift focus, your brain briefly suppresses visual input. This phenomenon, known as saccadic masking, ensures you perceive a continuous, stable world instead of dizzying blurs.
reveal_zh: 每当你的目光快速移动时，大脑会短暂抑制视觉输入。这种“扫视遮蔽”让你感知世界是连续稳定的，而非模糊不清。
meaning_en: Our perception of a stable reality is an active construction, not just a passive reception of sensory data.
meaning_zh: 我们对稳定现实的感知，是大脑主动建构的，而非被动接收感官数据。

visual.motion: Rapid eye movements followed by a seamless transition
